def load():

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

G=G
for p in [1,2,3]:
    g=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; w=f'Demo pair {p} output'
    print('=== pair',p, len(g),'x',len(g[0]))
    sr=[r for r in range(len(g)) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(len(g))) ]
    def runs(seps,n):
        res=[];prev=-1
        for x in (seps+[n]):
            if x>prev+1: res.append((prev+1,(x-1) if x<n else n-1))
            prev=x
        return res
    rb=runs(sr,len(g)); cb=runs(sc,len(g[0]))
    print('sepR',sr,'rb',rb)
    print('sepC',sc,'cb',cb)
    d=[(r,c,w[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]!=w[r][c]]
    cnt={}
    for r,c,v in d: cnt.setdefault(v,0); cnt[v]+=1
    print('fill colors:',dict(cnt))
    # summarize per-band per-mark: which blocks changed
    from collections import defaultdict
    bandmap=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in d: bandmap[bandmap.get(r,[])]
    print('bands changed:',sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in d)))

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape; bg=Counter(g.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i,j]==bg or seen[i,j]: continue
            c=int(g[i,j]); stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set(); seen[i,j]=True
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.add((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny,nx] and g[ny,nx]==c:
                        seen[ny,nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
            out.append((int(c),comp))
    return bg,out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # candidates: non-bg cells not orthogonally adjacent to a same-colored one, excluding bg
    def nbs(r,c):
        return [out[r+dr][c+dc] for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if abs(dr)+abs(dc)==1 and 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==bg or any(out[r+dr][c+dc]==v for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W):
                continue
            nb=Counter(nbs(r,c)); top,n2=nb.most_common(1)[0]
            # prefer non-bg neighbor
            best=max(nb.items(), key=lambda x:(x[1], -int(x[0]==bg)))
            out[r][c]=best[0]
    return out

def load():
    cands=glob.glob(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+glob.glob(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']+'/*')

        if not isinstance(p,str) or not os.path.isfile(p): continue
        try: t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n'); ok=True
        except Exception as e: ok=False
        if not ok: continue
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair (\d+) (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[3]),int(m[4])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

                v=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
                if k not in G: G[k]=v
    return G
